initiative: Reduce scrap rate on the stamping line at the Rochester plant

work_packages.title: Scrap cause analysis across all three shifts
work_packages.deliverable: Pareto analysis of scrap causes with measurement system study attached

work_packages.title: Die maintenance interval revision
work_packages.deliverable: Revised preventive maintenance standard with die change controls

work_packages.title: Operator standard work refresh
work_packages.deliverable: Updated standard work instructions and training records

approval_chain.name: Cause analysis gate review
approval_chain.criteria: Root causes traced to measurable process controls with no unexplained deviations

approval_chain.name: Standard revision gate review
approval_chain.criteria: Revised standards carry documented sign-off from quality and maintenance

risks.risk: Scrap reduction masks an underlying tooling wear problem
risks.mitigation: Track die wear measurements alongside the scrap deliverable each month
